Switchcars is truly an indie games that is an hidden gem.

A roguelike game where you travel 100 years (from 1950 to 2050) in order to escape atime travelling aliens slugs, with the help of every vehicle imaginable. With a synopsis like this, you would miss A LOT of hidden features:

There are truly A LOT of vehicles (horses, blimps, aircraft carriers, ekranoplanes just to name some);
Power ups that can be stacked (a flying nuclear powered airless tires  tugboat)
You can actually fight back the aliens
You have a "free" mode
You can mod your own vehicles
The scenaries changes thru time (like roads with modern asphalt)

It really is a fun, fast paced little gem, and I love it. Only thing I could say is that, regarding replayabilty, after winning the first run and completing the hardcore mode, you din't have much else. There aren't secrets, neither scoreboards.

But if you are serching for a time killing game, even for computers that aren't top of the line, this is a must.

In 3 words: fun, fast, creative.

This is game is a masterpiece. I have been watching its development for a long time and it did not disappoint when I finally got to play it. There are so many genius game design decisions that went into making it so much fun and thrilling.

It is both a love letter of some of the most exhilarating C64 and Amiga games of my childhood, but also a modern and fresh take on how to push their vision beyond.

I love the progressive difficulty of the game, and how the meta difficulty of the game adapts to your skill level with the year system. It is nice to be able to start the game at the edge of your comfort level and let the game push it further and further at your own pace.

At start, I was struggling with a single alien's attack, and at some point I was able to survive and kite bunch of them at the same time. There are so many decisions to be made at any given time, both to plan ahead for possible world changes that you are hinted at, but also to survive any given map and to proceed the fastest to the next one. Also, there is the constant consideration of whether to keep a vehicle or ditch it for another; whether to invest all your upgrades for a super vehicle that may be out of commission when its fuel runs out or when it gets destroyed, or to spread them among all three slots of vehicles that you have. These different hard decision sets help individualize your play style and come up with a big picture strategy on how you play the game.

I also love the variety of locations and vehicles. These do not only add a nice visual diversity to the game, but also found a great basis for presenting unique challenges and possible solutions to them.

Overall, this game is now in my top 10 games among the 35 years of gaming that I had with tens of thousands of titles.

Switchcars is a certified banger! The game is very well made - sporting a large inventory of usable vehicles, great sound design, and an addicting game loop. The procedural generation in levels/vehicles and the high-intensity soundtrack keeps each new run feeling fresh and exciting. 

Gameplay-wise, what you see in the trailers is what you get. Basically, you traverse left-to-right in hopes of reaching 'safe zone checkpoints' before the clock hits '00:00.' If the timer runs out before you reach a safe zone, you'll have to continue on but will now have to frantically avoid big floppy 'space slug' creatures who hound you mercilessly. Along the way, you can pick up 'power-ups' that improve your travel ability and you can also find 'mini-portals' that instantly teleport you across large sections of your path. Although deceptively simple in premise, the real challenge lies in deciding which types of vehicles to have in your roster, knowing when to switch between them, and securing/utilizing the random power-ups you stumble across along the way. 

Switchcars is a great value and is a perfect game for folks who like quicker 'get-in/get-out' gaming sessions.

Switchcars is amazing. It's fun, has an interesting concept, and with the new update, you can let your imagination run wild and create any car you want. I recommend taking a look at the tutorial for creating cars though, because when you got that down, you'll never want to stop making cars. 

Playing the run mode is adrenaline inducing and addictive. You have to travel right as far and as fast as you can before the aliens catch up and try to kill you. It makes you use strategies and tactics, from fleeing with an airplane to blowing them up into a million pieces with a tank. The game also has 1000+ vehicles to collect (and that's before mods) and multiple game modes, such as the run, hardcore, free ride, and the newly introduced rally mode, which requires you to travel as far as you can from the start with a time limit. Don't worry, you have 3 tries to get as far as you can. :)

Beating Switchcars leaves you with a huge surprise at the end (I'm not spoiling it of course) and it gives you a special free vehicle given to you personally by the Altfuture crew which is a thank you gift for playing their game. If you beat hardcore, something EVEN CRAZIER will happen, and you'll get a disclosed prize that will leave you in utter shock. 

Switchcars is diverse with content. You can start with the year 1950, where all the cars are slow, old and beat down, but it's much easier to escape the aliens and beat the game. Your protagonist has to travel to 2055 to witness the finest thing ever (still not spoiling it) and to get there, you have to travel through time with all sorts of vehicles, like small city cars, mid-sized sedans, motorcycles, large trucks, planes, trains, speed boats, ships, helicopters, sports cars, supercars, hypercars, even flying plasmacrafts and laser-shooting battlecrafts powered by ion drive built to soar through the thick and unforgiving space. You can even travel to dwarf planets and the alien planet, but be careful, the aliens know when they are being disturbed by an unknown residence.

In conclusion, Switchcars is absolutely amazing, as it's rich with content, fun, inspiring, and action-packed. There is also a special promotion, making this game 10% off until May 7th, so what are you waiting for? Jump into the action!
